Well, those are abandoned places, so it's hard for those photos to be joyful, but about most of them you're right - almost all industrial photos are from PRL, where we were part of USSR and we were very poor country. For most of the time there was almost no choice in food (to get some meat - if you were lucky! - you had to stay in line for literally hours, in worse times same applay to toilet paper). I'm not kidding - this was common; https://lehardi.files.wordpress.com/2013/01/2665-ii-kolejka.jpg

The only place where you could buy something was "pewex" - it was shop where you paid with dollars (mostly from family from rich countries, because averge salary in poland was ~1700pln in 60's - where 1$ cost between 70 and 90 - while in USA minimal wage was 1$ per hour.

That said, destiny can be fun. I don't think it's the kind of fun that is perennial enough to keep someone interested in the long term, but most who try it will probably get sucked in for a month or two before moving on.

Problems with Destiny:

  • Complete lack of social tools. It wants to be billed as an MMO, but doesn't give any tools to foster a community.
  • Illusion of open world. So much of destiny is on rails by way of the environment restricting your movement so you're always moving in one direction.
  • Horrible story. Seriously, fire the writers. I absolutely hated the entire Halo franchise for the same reason. People think there's some kind of deep story, but it's more shallow than a kiddie pool.
  • Stunning lack of meaningful content. For a game with that kind of budget, you'd expect a lot more than what got made.
  • Most of what is available to buy with in-game currency is cosmetic and does nothing in the way of making you feel more powerful. Factions have very little variation.
  • The devs genuinely don't care about the real problems, the playerbase is a cash register. There has been exactly zero movement to solve any of the core issues. Content trickles out in the form of expensive anemic DLC which are often completed in a short span of time.

Destiny is at its best when it's you and your friends doing strikes and raids. This is genuinely fun, and there's some challenge there. Destiny is at its worst with everything else.
